Bid Summary.value: The State of Maryland Treasurer's Office (contact: Tamaira Hawkins, thawkins@treasurer.state.md.us, 410-260-7533) is soliciting bids for Dell Latitude 5550 laptops with extended warranty (30 units) and Dell Thunderbolt 4 Docks (30 units), with detailed technical specifications including Intel Core Ultra 5 processor, 16GB DDR5 RAM, and Windows 11 Pro. Bids are due electronically via the eMaryland Marketplace Advantage (eMMA) e-Procurement system by 06/10/2024 at 2:00 PM EDT, with delivery required within 45 days of award. Key requirements include a Warranty Certificate or Affidavit upon award, Letter of Authorization from Dell or Distributor (if requested), and Mercury Affidavit. This procurement utilizes the Desktop, Laptop and Tablet 2015 Master Contract (060B5400007), and payment invoices must be submitted within 10 days of delivery to STOaccountspayable@treasurer.state.md.us with proof of delivery and equipment serial numbers.
